scope: v7.A per-unit verification channels — re-runnability, script existence, class coverage, reproducibility, CI integration
summary: v7.A verification gate is partially aspirational. 3 of 7 named scripts MISSING from repo. The system-viz-query.mjs `verify-bridge` subcommand DOES NOT EXIST (file has: roadmap-candidates|build-order|blast-radius|dispatcher-summary|coverage-by-domain|find|headline). Stripe CLI not in PATH. Total re-run cost ~62.5min — 12.5x the v7.D `<5min total` claim. No CI workflow runs the v7.A channels. 4 unit classes (hooks/skills/scripts/docs) have NO verification template.

rerun_cost_computation.ms2_invention_units_x_45s: 42 × 45s = 1890s (note: v7.B requires 21 test cases per algorithm per `≥3 spanning configs per axis × 7 axes` — actual cost likely 5-10x this)
rerun_cost_computation.gap_factor: 12.5x over claim (lower bound). If v7.B 21-case matrix per MS2 unit is applied, MS2 alone = 9450s = 158min, total = ~3.5hr
rerun_cost_computation.interpretation_note: v7.D §5 phrasing is ambiguous — could mean <5min per unit OR <5min for full roadmap pass. If per-unit: PASS for all classes except E2E (2min). If full-pass: massive FAIL (12.5x to 50x over).

findings.title: system-viz-query.mjs `verify-bridge` subcommand does not exist
findings.evidence: scripts/system-viz-query.mjs line 33 declares subcommands: roadmap-candidates|build-order|blast-radius|dispatcher-summary|coverage-by-domain|find|headline. v7.A Bridge row references `node scripts/system-viz-query.mjs verify-bridge --from <A> --to <B>` — this command will fail with usage error. Bridge coordination units have NO real verification channel.
findings.impact: Every Bridge-class unit currently shipped without enforcement; Stop hook scrutiny gate accepts aspirational `verifies_via` strings without execution check.
findings.fix: Either (a) implement `verify-bridge` subcommand in system-viz-query.mjs (~20 LOC: load graph, test edge presence, test both endpoints have actions wired), OR (b) rewrite v7.A Bridge row to use existing command (e.g. `node scripts/system-viz-query.mjs find <A> && find <B>`).

findings.title: scripts/spans-config-matrix.mjs and scripts/check-engine-wired.mjs DO NOT EXIST
findings.evidence: Glob H:/prism/scripts/spans-config-matrix.mjs → no files. Glob H:/prism/scripts/check-engine-wired.mjs → no files. mcp-server/scripts/ inventory does not contain these. Only build-milestone-progress.mjs, system-viz-query.mjs, and revenue-readiness-score.mjs exist of the 5 named in v7.A.
findings.impact: MS2 invention units (~42 units) and MS3 wiring units (~18 units) — 60 of 128 units (~47%) — have no functional verification channel. v7.A is therefore aspirational for ~half the roadmap.
findings.fix: Build scripts/spans-config-matrix.mjs (axis-spanning config runner) and scripts/check-engine-wired.mjs (dispatcher-enum + system-viz graph lookup) BEFORE MS0 kickoff. Add to v7.E META artifact build list.

findings.title: Stripe CLI not in PATH — MS1 webhook verification will fail
findings.evidence: `where.exe stripe` returns `INFO: Could not find files for the given pattern(s)`. v7.A MS1 row: `rtk vitest run -- <engine>.test.ts && stripe webhook --test <event>`. The `&&` short-circuit means stripe failure blocks the whole channel.
findings.impact: All 18 MS1 subscription engine units will have failing verification gates on first run. Stop hook will either block or auto-pass-after-3-attempts (escape hatch erosion).
findings.fix: (a) Install Stripe CLI on dev/CI machines, document in setup. (b) OR replace with mock webhook script: `node scripts/stripe-webhook-mock.mjs --event <event>`. (c) Document in v7.A row that Stripe CLI is prerequisite.

findings.title: Re-run cost claim `<5min total` (v7.D §5) is ambiguous and unsupported at full-pass scale
findings.evidence: Computed lower bound: 3750s (62.5min). Upper bound with v7.B 21-case matrix per MS2 unit: ~12,000s (200min). Spec text `<5min total` reads as full-roadmap. Even per-unit interpretation puts E2E (120s) at 40% of budget — leaves no margin.
findings.impact: Doctrine drift: ops team expects fast feedback loop; reality is multi-hour. Compounding-gains tax (v7.E) cannot rebuild readiness score in claimed time.
findings.fix: Either (a) rewrite v7.D §5 to `<5min per unit` with explicit `~60min full roadmap pass`, or (b) implement parallel verification runner (npx vitest --shard + playwright --workers) targeting ≤15min full-pass.

findings.title: Four unit classes have NO verification template in v7.A
findings.evidence: v7.A enumerates 7 templates: frontend, subscription, invention, wiring, drift, bridge, E2E. Missing: hooks (PRISM has 112 hook files), skills (~440 skills), scripts (88 scripts in mcp-server/scripts), docs (digests, wiki entries, directives).
findings.impact: Units in these classes ship without verification gates. Hook regressions, skill duplication, doc drift escape the v7.A net. Already a known failure mode — see `RESUME_AT_WORK.md` §8 silent-overwrite class.
findings.fix: Add 4 templates to v7.A: hook (`node .claude/hooks/<hook>.mjs --self-test`), skill (`node scripts/skill-lint.mjs <skill>`), script (`node <script> --help && shellcheck`), doc (`node scripts/wiki-lint.mjs <path> && node scripts/digest-drift-check.mjs`).

findings.title: Zero CI workflows execute v7.A verification channels
findings.evidence: .github/workflows/ has 7 yml files. Only ci.yml + web.yml reference vitest/playwright. None reference spans-config-matrix, check-engine-wired, build-milestone-progress, stripe webhook, or verify-bridge. ci.yml does NOT run playwright (web.yml does, but only for /web).
findings.impact: Verification is local-only. Multi-chat PRs can land with broken `verifies_via` declarations because CI doesn't enforce them. v7.A becomes a paper gate.
findings.fix: Add .github/workflows/revenue-roadmap-verify.yml: matrix job per unit class, runs the v7.A command, fails PR on red. Hook into existing scrutinize-before-stop ledger via artifact upload.

findings.title: Fresh-clone reproducibility gaps — implicit setup not documented
findings.evidence: v7.A commands assume: rtk in PATH (installs at C:\Users\wompu\bin per /rtk-setup; NOT in standard repo bootstrap), stripe CLI installed (no setup doc), playwright browsers downloaded (`playwright install` not in any bootstrap script), system-graph.json regenerated (`scripts/generate-system-viz.mjs` must run first or verify-bridge errors at line 41).
findings.impact: Fresh dev cannot execute any v7.A channel without 4+ undocumented setup steps. v7.G `/loop` re-audit on new agent worktrees will fail until setup replicated.
findings.fix: Ship `scripts/v7a-bootstrap.mjs` that: (1) checks rtk on PATH, (2) checks stripe CLI, (3) runs `playwright install --with-deps`, (4) regenerates system-graph if stale (>24hr), (5) emits PASS/FAIL with explicit remediation.

findings.title: v7.A signal definitions are unverifiable strings
findings.evidence: `expected_signal` column has prose like `≥3 configs per axis pass; emergent algorithm output stable across configs` (MS2 row) — no machine-readable predicate. Stop hook scrutiny ledger has no way to assert `output stable across configs` programmatically.
findings.impact: Verification PASS/FAIL becomes subjective; Claude-99eca613 marking ledger entries cannot be cross-validated by other chats. Erodes 3-of-3 consensus gate.
findings.fix: Each unit's `verifies_via` block must declare `expected_signal_predicate: { exit_code: 0, stdout_match: <regex>, artifact_path: <file>, artifact_check: <predicate> }`. Spans-config-matrix.mjs emits stable_hash; v7.A asserts hash equality across config N.

rerun_cost_summary_one_line: ~62.5min full roadmap pass (12.5x over v7.D '<5min' claim, 30x if MS2 21-axis matrix applied); ambiguity in spec phrasing is itself a finding.
